description: This file defines a class LoggerAppenderSyslog which is a PHP implementation of a logging appender that sends log events to the system's syslog facility, based on log levels. It is part of a PHP port of the log4j logging framework, specifically within the appenders subpackage.

classes.name: LoggerAppenderSyslog
classes.description: A PHP class that implements logging to the system's syslog, mapping different log levels to syslog severity levels, as part of the log4php framework.

methods.name: LoggerAppenderSyslog
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the appender with a given name.

methods.name: activateOptions
methods.description: Initializes syslog variables and marks the appender as open.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the syslog connection and marks the appender as closed.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Processes a logging event, determining the log level and sending the message to syslog with appropriate severity.
